name: Hotel Casa da Calçada Relais & Chateaux
positioning: A centuries-old riverside mansion in the historic part of Amarante, with rooms overlooking the Tâmega River, the Tempo Wellness Center and its own long-held vineyard
best_for: Travelers who want a historic house hotel right on the Tâmega in Amarante
Wine lovers drawn to a house that has owned a certified vineyard since 1917
Guests who want an indoor pool and spa circuit in a small-town setting

facts.text: Casa da Calçada is in the heart of Amarante, beside the waters of the Tâmega River.
The mansion is in the historic part of Amarante, right beside the Tâmega.
Casa da Calçada is a centuries-old property whose history blends with that of Amarante and Portugal.
Largo do Paço, with its fine dining offering, and Canto Redondo are the hotel's two restaurants.
Ciao Tílias overlooks the Tâmega River and serves Italian cuisine.
The Tempo treatment menu includes wellness rituals, massages, and facial and body treatments.
Room categories include Prestige River View.
Room categories include a Suite with balcony.

highlights.text: The mansion sits right on the banks of the river.
The house has owned the oldest certified vineyard in the region since 1917.
Conspiracies in the name of the republic were plotted at the house.
The Tempo Wellness Center has a heated indoor pool, sauna, Turkish bath, ice fountain, gym and a menu of treatments.
The suites and rooms overlook the Tâmega River and are designed as retreats of privacy, comfort and sophistication.

considerations.text: The Tempo Wellness Center welcomes visitors who are not staying at the hotel.
WhataHotel notes the small-town location has limited nightlife options.
